name: Artsdata-Crawler
description: The crawler for Artsdata, a public knowledge graph of performing-arts events, works, places, people and organizations. Its own permission page states the crawler's purpose as collecting publicly available arts and culture data, and describes its behaviour as respectful crawling with delays between requests. Site owners are asked to allow it rather than block it, and the page walks through robots.txt and Cloudflare bot protection as the two things that commonly stop it.
